title: UFO Whistleblower Makes Wild Alien Claims on Joe Rogan: "7-Foot' Reptilians, 'Greek Gods"
excerpt: David Grusch recently went on record discussing the range of different alien lifeforms that have visited Earth in recent years
content:
David Grusch, a well-known UFO whistleblower, has set the internet ablaze with his latest claims. During a recent appearance on "The Joe Rogan Experience" podcast, Grusch claimed that multiple different alien species are in contact with Earth and have even killed U.S. service members.

Grusch claimed that entities that resemble Greek Gods, 7-foot-tall reptiles, and small grays have all been zooming around the Earth in a range of UFOs. Grusch, a retired Air Force officer and former  intelligence officer at the National Geospatial Intelligence Agency, shared that he first became aware of the situation in 2020.

"Even for me, ex-deep state intel officer, I'm like, I cannot believe I'm talking about this on Joe Rogan. And I mean, I know it sounds schizo," Grusch said. "But one day people will replay the podcast and say, 'We thought he was crazy, but what do you know? It's true."

Later in the podcast, Grusch claimed that he'd previously seen video footage of a UFO crash site. In the footage, multiple dead alien bodies could be seen. His claim is that the video was shown due to an investigation he was working on, with his role being to corroborate its validity.

"At some point that story will come out. I'm sure the people who were in some of those events will speak publicly at some point," he said. "...You would think, it's like, would they get along? They're so advanced. But we have records of them f-king around with each other."

David Grusch Is Part of a Whistleblowing Coalition

Unfortunately for Grusch, most of his claims will be brushed aside by the majority of the population. That's why he's formed a coalition with fellow UFO whistleblowers Dylan Borland and Matthew Brown. The trio are now calling on President Donald Trump to allow them to share their secrets with the world.

"For the first time in history you have a direct public plea, not private . . . to the president of the United States, to have their NDAs waived and have them protected, so they can disclose what they know to the American population, because they feel like it's that important that everyone should be entitled to know that we're not alone," James Fox, a filmmaker, recently told The New York Post.

Grusch claims that he's "prepared to provide a full historical accounting to the National Security Council . . . and the White House Chief of Staff and make any supporting public statements that are authorized."

UFO's and aliens have been a common talking point recently, more so now than ever before. Still, at this point in time, none of us know whether we're truly alone in the universe. It seems like Grusch and his team believe they have the answer we're searching for.
